subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept the PR's waited A2A reply boundary that treats transcript-only OpenClaw rows, message-tool mirror rows, and inter_session assistant rows as non-deliverable artifacts?
rationale: This is a message-delivery invariant choice: the code looks coherent, but maintainers need to own which assistant transcript rows may be suppressed from source-reply extraction across A2A paths.

options.title: Accept The Boundary
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers agree that waited A2A reply extraction must stop at these transcript and inter-session artifacts.

options.title: Require Broader Live Proof
options.body: Ask for an additional real channel run if maintainer confidence depends on a non-mock transport demonstrating the same single-delivery result.

options.title: Narrow The Filter
options.body: Request a smaller predicate, such as sessions_send-specific inter_session filtering, if maintainers do not want all inter_session assistant rows treated as non-deliverable waited replies.

recommendation.title: Accept The Boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers agree that waited A2A reply extraction must stop at these transcript and inter-session artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent delivery-mirror provenance work is the closest adjacent merged ownership signal for this transcript/mirror boundary.
